improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial offer in the description creates a low-friction call to action.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace to run your business smarter. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the risk-free trial with 'no card required' to reduce friction and boost conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace built for serious business and trade professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion barrier—understanding what happens at the paywall. It reinforces the free trial value, clearly states pricing without hidden surprises, and highlights member benefits to motivate upgrade. Transparency builds trust and reduces friction at the critical decision point.
